summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its second-quarter 2026 shareholder report, including Management's Discussion and Analysis, interim financial statements, and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer covering the three and six months ended June 28, 2026, containing standard operational and financial disclosures. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or management change is indicated. The MD&A covers strategy, operating results, financial condition, cash flows, liquidity, legal proceedings, and risk factors. The report was reviewed by the Audit and Finance Committee and approved by the Board on July 29, 2026. This is an ordinary quarterly filing with no deal terms or special-situation elements.
